name: Online shop
summary: Orders, revenue by channel, average order value, conversion, returns and sessions, with a weekly dashboard and a Workflow that asks for the week's numbers on Monday.

whatItsFor.text: For an online shop that looks at its week: orders, revenue by channel, the average order, how many visitors buy and how much comes back.

items: The week's figures from your shop and your analytics: orders, online revenue, conversion rate, return rate and sessions.
Free room for the Metrics in your Workspace's size: the Set up form says how many it makes and how many fit.
Open **Settings**, then **Packs**. Under this Pack, choose **Set up from this Pack**.

Keep the Metrics you want ticked, up to all 6, with the dashboard **Shop weekly** and the Workflow **Monday numbers**. Leave **Make me the Submitter of their values** ticked if you send the figures yourself, else untick it. Setting up sends no request unless you tick **Send the first requests now**. Choose **Set up**.

If someone else sends figures, do this right after Set up: open the **Setup Guide** from **Help**, choose **Team**, and under **Who is asked for what** pick the person for each Metric and press **Ask**. It lists your ten newest Metrics.
Send the first figures: open a Metric you submit and choose **Record a value**, or answer the request the Workflow sends at its next run.
Open **Dashboards** and then **Shop weekly**. It fills as values come in.
**Average order value**, which Ziffr works out as online revenue divided by orders.

The Workflow **Monday numbers**: due on Monday, with a reminder that day. A change of more than 40 % or a value outside its target is marked as unusual. A figure that is still missing after its Due Date is raised with the Metric's owner.

questions.text: How do I see revenue by channel?
Record **Online revenue** with a **Breakdown**, one line for each channel.

metric.name: Orders
metric.description: Orders placed in the week, including those later cancelled or returned.
metric.calculationNote: Orders placed from Monday to Sunday, counted on the day of the order, including those later cancelled or returned. Test orders are left out.

metric.name: Online revenue
metric.description: Revenue from online orders in the week, excluding VAT and shipping fees, before returns. Record it with a Breakdown by channel to see where it comes from.
metric.calculationNote: What customers ordered from Monday to Sunday, after discounts and vouchers. VAT and shipping fees are left out, and later returns are not taken off.

metric.name: Average order value
metric.description: Online revenue divided by the number of orders, in the week.
metric.calculationNote: Online revenue of the week divided by its number of orders. VAT and shipping fees are not in it, because they are not in the revenue.

metric.name: Conversion rate
metric.description: Share of website visitors who placed an order.
metric.calculationNote: Orders placed in the week divided by visits to the shop in the same week, in percent. A person who visits twice counts as two visits.

metric.name: Return rate
metric.description: Items returned as a share of items sold, by the week of sale.
metric.calculationNote: Items sent back divided by items sold, in percent, counted in the week the item was sold. The figure of a recent week can still rise.

metric.name: Sessions
metric.description: Visits to the online shop in the week; one person can have several.
metric.calculationNote: Visits counted by your web analytics from Monday to Sunday. One person visiting twice counts twice, and known bots are left out.
